children.text: Azmat Chandio is a Research Assistant at NC4SCM, NED University of Engineering & Technology, driven by a strong commitment to advancing sustainable materials, waste valorization, and eco-friendly infrastructure solutions. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Metallurgy and Materials Engineering from Mehran University and a master’s degree in Materials Engineering from NED University of Engineering & Technology. Blending his academic foundation with hands-on industrial experience as a Production and Quality Assurance Engineer in major steel manufacturing facilities, his research integrates advanced nanomaterial synthesis, electrochemical testing, and the development of sustainable, low-carbon building solutions. He has worked on multiple peer-reviewed publications in international journals focusing on catalytic applications, polymer nanocomposites, and corrosion behavior.
